record_title: Exact total-variation leakage of uniform low-rank factor masks
provenance: A rank-conditioned likelihood calculation sharpens the approximate row/column individual-security bound for uniform low-rank factor masks to an exact total-variation identity and a matching rank-surplus threshold.
limitations: Uniform independent factors and uniform inputs only; no exact formula is claimed for rank-ball masks, nonuniform factor laws, correlated inputs, or other privacy metrics. The generic finite-field factorization counts may be folklore, and near-simultaneous priority risk is material because the motivating preprint is recent.
